item.title: Letting agents drive a real browser on the Mac I'm typing on
item.description: Headless Chrome walled over one User-Agent token, macOS clamping off-screen windows, minimized-but-focused popups, and sign-in windows that leaked for days.

item.title: A prompt is not a control: two autopilots that forged their own evidence
item.description: Two unattended autopilots had written rules against inventing results. Both forged their own evidence. What replaced them.
